verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּאֶחָד֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî baš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ lə·ṣê·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai He said
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, na tenda da congregação, no primeiro dia do segundo mês, no segundo ano da sua saída da terra do Egito, dizendo:

verses.original: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū ’eṯ- rōš kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ kāl- zā·ḵār lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: Take a census - of the whole congregation . . . of Israel by their clans and families . . . listing every man by name one by one
verses.literalPt: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, segundo as suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes de todo o homem, cabeça por cabeça;

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kāl- yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā bə·yiś·rā·’êl tip̄·qə·ḏū ’ō·ṯām lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām ’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age . . . or older by their divisions everyone who can serve in Israel’s army
verses.literalPt: Da idade de vinte anos para cima, todos os que em Israel podem sair à guerra, a estes contareis segundo os seus exércitos, tu e Arão.

verses.original: וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’it·tə·ḵem yih·yū ’îš ’îš lam·maṭ·ṭeh ’îš rōš lə·ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw hū
verses.literal: And one man . . . from each tribe the head of each family . . . . . . must be there with you
verses.literalPt: Estará convosco, de cada tribo, um homem que seja cabeça da casa de seus pais.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ya·‘am·ḏū ’it·tə·ḵem lir·’ū·ḇên ’ĕ·lî·ṣūr ben- šə·ḏê·’ūr
verses.literal: These are the names of the men who are to assist you From the tribe of Reuben Elizur son of Shedeur
verses.literalPt: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos homens que estarão convosco: De Rúben, Elizur, filho de Sedeur;

verses.original: לְשִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šim·‘ō·wn šə·lu·mî·’êl ben- ṣū·rî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: from Simeon Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai
verses.literalPt: De Simeão, Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai;

verses.original: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lî·hū·ḏāh naḥ·šō·wn ben- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: from Judah Nahshon son of Amminadab
verses.literalPt: De Judá, Naasson, filho de Aminadabe;

verses.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār nə·ṯan·’êl ben- ṣū·‘ār
verses.literal: from Issachar Nethanel son of Zuar
verses.literalPt: De Issacar, Natanael, filho de Zuar;

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: liz·ḇū·lun ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ben- ḥê·lōn
verses.literal: from Zebulun Eliab son of Helon
verses.literalPt: De Zebulom, Eliabe, filho de Helom;

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ lə·’ep̄·ra·yim ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ ben- ‘am·mî·hūḏ lim·naš·šeh gam·lî·’êl ben- pə·ḏā·h·ṣūr
verses.literal: from the sons of Joseph from Ephraim Elishama son of Ammihud and from Manasseh Gamaliel son of Pedahzur
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de José: De Efraim, Elisama, filho de Amiúde; de Manassés, Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur;

verses.original: לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇin·yā·min ’ă·ḇî·ḏān ben- giḏ·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: from Benjamin Abidan son of Gideoni
verses.literalPt: De Benjamim, Abidã, filho de Gideoni;

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏān ’ă·ḥî·‘e·zer ben- ‘am·mî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: from Dan Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai
verses.literalPt: De Dã, Aieser, filho de Amisadai;

verses.original: לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ā·šêr paḡ·‘î·’êl ben- ‘ā·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: from Asher Pagiel son of Ocran
verses.literalPt: De Aser, Pagiel, filho de Ocrã;

verses.original: לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡāḏ ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- də·‘ū·’êl
verses.literal: from Gad Eliasaph son of Deuel
verses.literalPt: De Gade, Eliasafe, filho de Deuel;

verses.original: לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·nap̄·tā·lî ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: and from Naphtali Ahira son of Enan
verses.literalPt: De Naftali, Aira, filho de Enã.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה קְרִיאֵי הָעֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh qə·rī·ʾē hā·‘ê·ḏāh nə·śî·’ê maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām rā·šê ’al·p̄ê yiś·rā·’êl hêm
verses.literal: These men were appointed from the congregation they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers the heads of the clans of Israel
verses.literalPt: Estes foram os chamados da congregação, os príncipes das tribos de seus pais, os cabeças dos milhares de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’êṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron - took these men who had been designated by name
verses.literalPt: Então tomaram Moisés e Arão a estes homens, que foram declarados pelos seus nomes,

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh hiq·hî·lū bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî way·yiṯ·yal·ḏū ‘al- miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families . . . counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age . . . or older
verses.literalPt: E reuniram toda a congregação no primeiro dia do mês segundo, e declararam a sua descendência segundo as suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, cabeça por cabeça;

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm bə·miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: just as the LORD had commanded Moses So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai
verses.literalPt: Como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés, assim os contou no deserto de Sinai.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵōr yiś·rā·’êl tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army
verses.literalPt: Foram, pois, os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo o homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh rə·’ū·ḇên šiš·šāh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Rúben, quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê šim·‘ō·wn tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām pə·qu·ḏāw bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Simeon according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Simeão, as suas gerações pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa dos seus pais; os seus contados, pelo número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo o homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh šim·‘ō·wn tiš·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Simeão, cinqüenta e nove mil e trezentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê ḡāḏ tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Gad according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting the names of all those twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Gade, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֑ד חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḡāḏ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Gade, quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos e cinqüenta.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yə·hū·ḏāh tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mōṯ mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Judah according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting the names of all those twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Judá, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais; pelo número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh yə·hū·ḏāh ’ar·bā·‘āh wə·šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600 . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Zebulom, cinqüenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mōṯ mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Efraim, quarenta mil e quinhentos.

verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê mə·naš·šeh tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ

verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Manassés, trinta e dois mil e duzentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֑ן חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇin·yā·min ḥă·miš·šāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Benjamim, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḏān šə·na·yim wə·šiš·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ

verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Dã, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh ’ā·šêr ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Aser, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî šə·lō·šāh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Foram contados deles, da tribo de Naftali, cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וּנְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו הָיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh hap·pə·qu·ḏîm ’ă·šer pā·qaḏ mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ū·nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ’îš ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw hā·yū
verses.literal: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron with the assistance of the twelve . . . . . . . . . leaders of Israel each one representing his family . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes foram os contados, que contaram Moisés e Arão, e os príncipes de Israel, doze homens, cada um era pela casa de seus pais.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū kāl- pə·qū·ḏê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kāl- yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So all the Israelites . . . twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim foram todos os contados dos filhos de Israel, segundo a casa de seus pais, de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra em Israel;

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū kāl- hap·pə·qu·ḏîm šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: And all those counted totaled 603,550 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos os contados eram seiscentos e três mil e quinhentos e cinqüenta.

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּתוֹכָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim lə·maṭ·ṭêh ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lō hā·ṯə·pā·qə·ḏū bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: The Levites, however were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Mas os levitas, segundo a tribo de seus pais, não foram contados entre eles,

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: For the LORD . . . had said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Porquanto o SENHOR tinha falado a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־ מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְאֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭêh lê·wî lō ṯip̄·qōḏ wə·’eṯ- rō·šām lō ṯiś·śā bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census . . . . . . with the other Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém não contarás a tribo de Levi, nem tomarás a soma deles entre os filhos de Israel;

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־ מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh hap̄·qêḏ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim ‘al- miš·kan hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ wə·‘al kāl- kê·lāw wə·‘al kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw hêm·māh yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·hêm yə·šā·rə·ṯu·hū wə·sā·ḇîḇ lam·miš·kān ya·ḥă·nū
verses.literal: Instead you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony . . . all its furnishings . . . and everything in it They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles . . . care for it and camp around it
verses.literalPt: Mas tu põe os levitas sobre o tabernáculo do testemunho, e sobre todos os seus utensílios, e sobre tudo o que pertence a ele; eles levarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios; e eles o administrarão, e acampar-se-ão ao redor do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·sō·a‘ ham·miš·kān yō·w·rî·ḏū ’ō·ṯōw hal·wî·yim ū·ḇa·ḥă·nōṯ ham·miš·kān yā·qî·mū ’ō·ṯōw hal·wî·yim wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whenever the tabernacle is to move the Levites are to take it down and whenever it is to be pitched the Levites are to set it up Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death
verses.literalPt: E, quando o tabernáculo partir, os levitas o desarmarão; e, quando o tabernáculo se houver de assentar no arraial, os levitas o armarão; e o estranho que se chegar morrerá.

verses.original: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־ מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־ דִּגְל֖וֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·nū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš ‘al- ma·ḥă·nê·hū wə·’îš ‘al- diḡ·lōw lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . are to camp by their divisions each man in his own camp . . . and under his own standard
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel armarão as suas tendas, cada um no seu esquadrão, e cada um junto à sua bandeira, segundo os seus exércitos.

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim ya·ḥă·nū sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·kan hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ wə·lō- yih·yeh qe·ṣep̄ ‘al- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·šā·mə·rū hal·wî·yim ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ miš·kan hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ
verses.literal: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony
verses.literalPt: Mas os levitas armarão as suas tendas ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho, para que não haja indignação sobre a congregação dos filhos de Israel, pelo que os levitas terão o cuidado da guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Thus the Israelites . . . did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel; conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés, assim o fizeram.
